$comment: Core saved views (services/state/state.ts). Data, not code: each is a stored query_state query, seeded as a `core` row and copied when a person tailors one. `$me` is the person asking; dates may be relative (-14d, +24h, now).

views.name: Email replies I owe
views.description: Email threads where the other side wrote last and is waiting on my answer, longest-waiting first.

views.name: Waiting on their reply
views.description: Email threads where I wrote last more than 3 days ago and have heard nothing back.

views.name: Meetings to prepare for
views.description: Meetings in the next 24 hours with someone from outside the company.

views.name: Stale deals
views.description: Open deals with no change in the CRM for 14 days.

views.name: My overdue tasks
views.description: Issues assigned to me that are past their due date and not done.

views.name: Pull requests awaiting my review
views.description: Open pull requests where my review is requested.

views.name: Slack mentions of me
views.description: Slack messages that mention me in the last 7 days. Matches a mention by my Slack member id, so save your own copy with it as `slack_member` if none come back.

views.name: Approvals waiting on me
views.description: Decisions in the review queue that are mine to make: asks, approvals and proposed actions.

views.name: Overdue invoices
views.description: Invoices past their due date with a balance still owed.

views.name: Broken connections
views.description: Connected systems whose last sync failed, with the reason.
